notes:
v4.6.27 — Cloud auto-start (works with APEX closed) + bot heartbeat + CLAUDE_MODEL fix

✨ NEW — Cloud-side auto-start scheduler
• Cloud bots set to auto-start at market open now actually start at market open EVEN WHEN APEX IS CLOSED. Previously the scheduler ran inside the desktop GUI as a QTimer — quitting APEX killed the scheduler too. The new server/auto_scheduler.py runs as a daemon thread inside uvicorn on Oracle, polls Alpaca's clock every 60 seconds, and fires start_bot for each user's scheduled sides on the market-open edge.
• Per-bot auto-start flags now sync from the desktop to the server in the credentials payload (APEX_AUTO_SCHEDULE_<SIDE>=1/0). Toggling a checkbox in Overview AUTOMATION pushes the new state to Oracle immediately.
• Works for built-ins (LONG/SHORT/DAY) AND uploaded custom bots — the scheduler scans /opt/apex_users/user_X/private_bots/ for slug detection.

🛡️ Bot loop heartbeat
• BotRunner's outer loop now wraps each cycle in try/except so a transient API hiccup doesn't kill the bot. The 300s sleep between cycles is now a heartbeat sleep that prints '[bot] sleeping · cycle N · next tick in Xs' every 60s so users can see the bot is alive — previously the 5-min gap was indistinguishable from a crash.
• Same heartbeat pattern wired into the crypto bot template directly.

🐛 FIXED
• longbot_v2 / shortbot_v2 / daybot all crashed with 'NameError: CLAUDE_MODEL is not defined' on startup. The codebase migrated from a hardcoded CLAUDE_MODEL constant to _AI_MODEL (loaded from each bot's AI config) but the startup banner prints kept referencing the deleted global. Fixed in all three. Already deployed to Oracle so cloud bots work right now.
• v4.6.26 bundles (portfolio cleanup, AI syntax validation, local custom bot launch, slot dropdown refresh, Make Bot KeyError, AI return charts, per-bot lifetime, dual download buttons, ...).
